_about: Every number on synthe.live comes from this file. Since November 2026 the site sells Synthe's self-improving agents (github.com/synthelabs/synthe); each of those facts lists its source under _manual. The checker_* and beta_* facts belong to the retired commit-barrier pages (noindexed, kept in the repo); tools/facts.py refresh re-measures those from the old public checker. tools/facts.py apply writes the values into each page's data-fact spans; tools/check_site.py fails CI when a page disagrees.
